blocks.text: Powered by the hot shooting of Nic Cabañero and Carlo Lastimosa, the host Biñan Tatak Gel defeated Rizal XentroMall anew, 81-67, on Wednesday to arrange a rematch with Quezon Province in the South Division Finals of the SportsPlus MPBL 2026 Season at the Alonte Sports Arena....
